reference_sql:
WITH copied_sets AS (  -- one row per set of two or more matching lines
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS DATE) AS order_month, SUM(cs.n_lines - 1) AS n_copies
FROM copied_sets cs
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = cs.order_id
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS DATE)

solver.query:
WITH sets AS (SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS DATE) AS order_month, SUM(s.n - 1) AS n_copies
FROM sets s
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE s.n > 1
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS DATE)
